entry.title: Nine sellers cannot price a grade
entry.summary: The same-hour spread across European H100 sellers was 7.40x on 7 September, and no regression on that panel can say how much of it is quality. entry.title: A GPU-hour is a part number, not a unit
entry.summary: The index records an interconnect for all 7,798 observations and has observed one for none of them, 805 rows assert an SXM part and a PCIe bus at the same time, and nothing the index had stored described a fabric, a power envelope or a thermal limit.

entry.title: Compute prices barely move. Where you buy moves everything.
entry.summary: Five of nine European sellers never changed their H100 price once in fifty days, the same-hour spread across sellers was 8.56x, and the hyperscaler rate cards are region-flat to four decimal places, which is the argument for regional benchmarks and not the argument most people make for them.
